gloss: the period right after a vacation; post-vacation

definitions.gloss: the period right after a vacation; post-vacation
definitions.explanation: the time immediately after returning from a holiday or time off

examples.japanese: {休暇明|きゅうかあ}けは{仕事|しごと}がつらい。
examples.english: Work is tough right after vacation.

examples.japanese: {休暇明|きゅうかあ}けにメールが{大量|たいりょう}にたまっていた。
examples.english: A huge number of emails had piled up when I came back from vacation.

examples.japanese: {長期|ちょうき}{休暇明|きゅうかあ}けは{生活|せいかつ}リズムを{戻|もど}すのに{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: After a long vacation, it takes time to get back into your routine.

notes:
Composed of {休暇|きゅうか} (vacation, time off) + {明|あ}け (the period after something ends). The {明|あ}け suffix is productive and attaches to various nouns to indicate the period immediately following: {正月明|しょうがつあ}け (after New Year's), {梅雨明|つゆあ}け (after the rainy season), {夜明|よあ}け (dawn, after night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休暇明|きゅうかあ}けの{月曜日|げつようび}: the Monday after vacation
- {長期|ちょうき}{休暇明|きゅうかあ}け: after a long vacation
- {休暇明|きゅうかあ}けに{出社|しゅっしゃ}する: to go to work after vacation
- {休暇明|きゅうかあ}けの{憂鬱|ゆううつ}: post-vacation blues

RELATED PATTERNS WITH {明|あ}け:
- {正月明|しょうがつあ}け: after the New Year holiday
- {連休明|れんきゅうあ}け: after a consecutive holiday period
- {盆明|ぼんあ}け: after the Obon holiday
- GW{明|あ}け: after Golden Week
